preconditions.description: The length of the input string s is between 1 and 10, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Each character in the input string s is a lowercase English letter.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'NA' or a string of length between 1 and 10 that is a palindrome.
